name: day-trader-skill-india
description: The Day Trader skill pack for Claude, India edition (NSE, Zerodha)

plugins.name: day-trader-skill-india
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading Indian stocks: an NSE chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner on NSE's tick grid, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager that shows Zerodha's charges, an order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts, an earnings analyst and a big bull tracker (bulk and block deals).
